sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
sources.scope: Risk management framework; not product certification.
sources.recheck_when: NIST publishes a revision or guide adopts specific controls.

sources.title: NIST Generative AI Profile (AI 600-1)
sources.scope: Cross-sector generative AI risk guidance; the AI RMF is under revision.
sources.recheck_when: NIST revises the AI RMF or publishes a new GenAI profile.

sources.title: OWASP GenAI Security Project
sources.scope: Threat and mitigation references; use a dated edition and verify current publication status.
sources.recheck_when: OWASP publishes a new list or the AI threat guidance is changed.

sources.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
sources.scope: Application security verification requirements; select requirements by product risk.
sources.recheck_when: A new ASVS version is announced or guide cites a requirement number.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework
sources.scope: Secure development practices; confirm current revision before policy use.
sources.recheck_when: NIST posts a draft/final revision or examples cite a control.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-82 Operational Technology Security
sources.scope: OT security guidance; Rev. 4 draft status noted in September 2026.
sources.recheck_when: NIST releases a new draft/final or before adopting an edition as policy.

sources.title: HHS Guidance on HIPAA and Cloud Computing
sources.scope: U.S. HIPAA contexts; not an applicability determination.
sources.recheck_when: HHS updates guidance or an example discusses provider obligations.

sources.title: CFPB Personal Financial Data Rights resource
sources.scope: U.S.-specific regulatory resource; check current rule and litigation status.
sources.recheck_when: CFPB or courts update rule status; before any implementation decision.

sources.title: PCI Security Standards Council document library
sources.scope: Payment-card standards and documents; applicability depends on the payment environment.
sources.recheck_when: Before a product touches account data or describes a validation path.

sources.title: ABA Model Rule 1.6: Confidentiality of Information
sources.scope: U.S. model rule; verify local adoption and rules.
sources.recheck_when: ABA revises the model rule or a guide makes a jurisdiction-specific claim.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Education Student Privacy Resource Center
sources.scope: U.S. education privacy resources, including FERPA guidance.
sources.recheck_when: Department publishes updated guidance or a product handles student records.

sources.title: Your Europe: Data protection under GDPR
sources.scope: EU business overview; assess applicability and national rules.
sources.recheck_when: EU guidance or legislation changes or a product enters an EU market.

sources.title: FTC Advertising and Marketing
sources.recheck_when: FTC updates guidance/rules or marketing claims/testimonials are discussed.

sources.title: Google Search Essentials
sources.scope: Google Search eligibility and quality guidance; no ranking guarantee.
sources.recheck_when: Google updates Search Essentials or AI-search guidance.

sources.title: Google guidance on optimizing for generative AI search features
sources.scope: Google-specific search guidance; not a universal discovery standard.
sources.recheck_when: Google changes this guide or the growth guide mentions GEO/AEO tactics.

sources.title: U.S. Small Business Administration: Plan your business
sources.scope: U.S. small-business research, startup cost, and planning resources.
sources.recheck_when: SBA moves or revises resources cited by pricing/market guides.

sources.title: U.S. Small Business Administration: Manage your business
sources.scope: U.S. bookkeeping, finance, and compliance starting points.
sources.recheck_when: SBA moves or revises resources cited by the cash-flow guide.
